title: Count Subsets with Given Sum
statement:
Given an array of non-negative integers and a target T, count the number of subsets whose elements sum to exactly T.

Each element can be included or excluded. Two subsets are different if they differ in which elements are chosen (by index, not value).
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and T.
The second line contains N space-separated non-negative integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the count of subsets summing to T.
